meta.name: cobrapy
meta.description: Constraint-based metabolic modeling (COBRA). FBA, FVA, gene knockouts, flux sampling, SBML models, for systems biology and metabolic engineering analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析代谢网络模型，模拟基因敲除与通量分布
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在做代谢网络建模或代谢工程分析
copy.tagline_en: Analyze metabolic network models, simulate gene knockouts and flux distributions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are working on constraint-based metabolic modeling or metabolic engineering analysis

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以用 cobrapy 分析基因组规模代谢模型，执行通量平衡分析（FBA）、通量变异性分析（FVA）、基因敲除筛选、通量采样等操作，并支持模型导入导出和最小培养基计算。
howto.when: 当你需要加载或构建代谢模型、运行 FBA/FVA、进行基因或反应敲除分析，或者优化生长介质时触发。

say.text: 加载大肠杆菌核心模型并运行FBA，显示生长速率。
对iJO1366模型进行单个基因敲除筛选，找出必需基因。
计算最小培养基成分，仅保留必需交换。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use cobrapy to analyze genome-scale metabolic models: perform FBA, FVA, gene knockout screens, flux sampling, import/export models, and compute minimal media.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to load or build a metabolic model, run FBA/FVA, perform gene or reaction deletion analysis, or optimize growth media.

say_en.text: Load the E. coli core model and run FBA to display the growth rate.
Conduct single gene deletion screen on the iJO1366 model to find essential genes.
Compute the minimal medium composition keeping only essential exchanges.
